simple.meaning: כְּרִית (Kᵉrîyth) is a place-name in the Hebrew text (H3747). BibleIQ follows its 2 occurrences across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This place appears in 1 Kings, beginning at 1 Kings 17:3. The occurrence trail shows where the place enters the biblical story.

simple.whyItMatters: Places in Scripture often connect geography, covenant history, judgment, worship, and movement through the land. BibleIQ keeps the place tied to its actual verse trail.
